item.title: MVA audit finds deficiencies
item.description: THE Marianas Visitors Authority failed to follow key procurement and payroll procedures during fiscal year 2023, resulting in three significant internal control deficiencies, according to an independent audit covering fiscal years 2022 and 2023.
